lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.quote: Article III of the $1987$ Constitution is the **Bill of Rights**.
lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.note: The year, count, section numbers, and section ranges in teaching prose are now enclosed in inline math.

lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.quote: How many sections make up Article III of the $1987$ Constitution?
lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.note: The count question is direct; other examples likewise ask the constitutional question itself.

lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.quote: 1. The case concerns the government's basis and steps for taking property.
lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.note: Multistep solutions begin in numbered lists; the count answer is a permitted one-step sentence.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Also check whether the action has a lawful basis.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Due-process analysis checks lawful basis, notice, and a chance to answer, with varying procedures.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: The grouping must fit the law's purpose, apply beyond present conditions, and treat everyone in the same group alike.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Equal-protection grouping analysis gives the four basic checks and warns of stricter review.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A judge must personally decide whether it exists.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Warrant requirements, different judicial procedures, particularity, exceptions, and exclusion are developed.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: It also allows an exception when public safety or order requires it, as provided by law.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Both lawful court order and statutory public-safety or public-order exceptions are specified.
Speech and expression are explained with government restriction checks and a criticism example.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A report need not praise the government to receive protection.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Press freedom is taught and applied to a newspaper criticism ban.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: This protection does not give permission for violence.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Peaceful assembly has a plain meaning, peacefulness condition, and worked gathering case.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: The right to ask does not promise that the request will be granted.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Petition for redress is defined, illustrated, and distinguished from guaranteed approval.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: No **religious test** may be required to exercise civil or political rights.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Non-establishment, free exercise, religious tests, and conduct limits are all taught.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Within limits set by law, it may be restricted only upon a lawful court order.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Abode has its own court-order condition and a worked contrast with travel.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: It may be restricted for national security, public safety, or public health, as provided by law.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The three constitutional travel grounds are distinguished from the abode rule.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Access is subject to limits provided by law.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Citizen records access, policy data, confidentiality, and verification of limits are taught.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: The purpose must not be contrary to law.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Lawful association, employee coverage, and a worked public-employee example are supplied.

lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.quote: A citizen requests government policy research data.
lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.note: The rewrite adds numerous location and application cases, including lawful-access limits in Example 18. This optional catalogue-coverage request is addressed; the separate removed debt case is recorded under L18.
